title: Weak control keeps execution open while verification and release remain bounded
problem: When patch verification, release review, and self-model reflection all run as hard gates, the daemon drifts back into fake progress or stale runtime states.
signals: control layer becomes constrained because patch gate is attention
self_model runs in-band or dominates active delivery priorities

adopted_fix.artifact_value_rule: count only valuable real artifacts with production-focus, release-candidate, or explicit value-contract evidence

guardrails: execution must not be blocked by delayed verification
release blocking must be limited to sampled release-critical evidence
internal recovery demos must not count toward products_real
